notes: Access route: robots.txt (checked first, curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation) carries NO Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow -- only generic Disallow rules for /webviews/, /forum, /*/checkout, */search, /*/facet_clp/*, /*/collection/*, /*?page= etc, plus 'Sitemap: https://www.meesho.com/sitemap.xml'. Plain requests/WebFetch/r.jina.ai were all blocked (403 Akamai/WAF); curl_cffi with impersonate='safari17_2_ios' was the only profile of 10+ tried that reliably returned real SSR HTML (chrome124/120 returned an Akamai JS challenge page at 200, chrome110/101/99/116 returned 403). Scoped strictly to the Home & Kitchen mega-menu as instructed (did not enumerate the whole site or use disallowed /search). Meesho's Home & Kitchen nav is grouped into 4 sub-menus: 'Home Decor' (Covers, Key Holders, Artificial Plants, Pooja Needs, Party Supplies, Wallpapers & Stickers, Showpieces & Idols, Clocks & Wall Decor), 'Kitchenware' (Storage & Organizers, Cookware, Kitchen Tools, Kitchen Appliances, Dinnerware, Glasses & Barware, Kitchen Linen), 'Home Textiles' (Bedsheets, Curtains, Carpets, Pillow/Cushion Covers, Blankets), and 'Home Essentials' (Bathroom Accessories, Cleaning Supplies, Gardening, Home Tools, Shoe Racks, Study Tables, Wardrobes, Wall Shelves, Home Temple, Hammock Swings). Excluded per project scope: Covers, Key Holders, Artificial Plants (explicit exclude), Pooja Needs, Party Supplies, Wallpapers & Stickers (explicit exclude), all Kitchenware sub-cats except Dinnerware/Glassware (cookware/tools/appliances/linen excluded), all Home Textiles (textiles excluded), all Home Essentials (checked 'Bathroom Accessories' by sample -- dominated by pipe fittings, towel bars, foil wraps, i.e. storage/plumbing, not genuinely decorative -- excluded; rest are furniture/storage/tools/garden, excluded). NO distinct navigable 'Lighting' or 'Mirrors' tab exists anywhere in the Home & Kitchen mega-menu (checked full 363-entry navUrls list for light/lamp/mirror/bulb/chandelier keywords -- only non-home hits were 'Selfie Stick & Ringlight' and 'Bike LED Lights', both other departments). A single wall-lamp product was spotted inside the SEO sample of the mixed 'Home Decor > View All' bucket, confirming lighting items exist on-platform but are NOT exposed as their own browsable category -- per Rule 0 this is a real navigation absence, not a room-name exclusion, and per the 'do not enumerate the whole site' instruction I did not attempt to construct a synthetic Lighting category via disallowed site search. Dropped 'Home Decor > View All' (/home-decor/pl/3tl) itself as a row: JSON-LD SEO sample showed it is a mixed roll-up of wall hooks, switch-panel stickers, pooja backdrop curtains, key holders, incense holders alongside decor items -- per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' only the two clean named sub-tabs (Clocks & Wall Decor; Showpieces & Idols) were kept as leaf rows. QTY: exact counts are unattainable for every row -- Meesho's PLP pages are Next.js shells whose product grid and totalProductsCount are populated by a client-side XHR after hydration (confirmed via __NEXT_DATA__: clpListing.listing.products=[] and totalProductsCount=0 in the raw SSR payload); no public API base URL was discoverable in the shipped JS chunks, and the likely count/facet endpoints (*/facet_clp/*, */search) are themselves robots.txt-disallowed, so exact-count verification could not be performed by any permitted route. All 4 leaf rows are therefore qty:null with MANUAL REVIEW flags -> status is 'partial' per the null-fraction rule. Duplicate-company determination: this worker has no visibility into the rest of the master company list; SR is pre-labelled 'Meesho Home & Kitchen' (department-scoped), which suggests the list curator already separated it from any general 'Meesho' marketplace-wide entry -- flagging for orchestrator to confirm no separate plain 'Meesho' row exists to avoid double-counting.
